ig_artist.full_name: Jordan Novak | Helping teams sell better

caption.text:
They say you can’t run a company from a reading room… but we tried it anyway

From quiet client calls (even when they’re not allowed) to planning sprints and checking the numbers, we’ve shown that the work happens wherever you sit down.

It’s not about having a fancy office—it’s about using what’s in front of you and staying on task. Whether it’s a reading room, a café, or a park bench, if you’ve got the focus, the progress follows.

All you really need to start is patience and a Wi-Fi connection. Everything else is optional.
